planets.name: K2-332 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-332 with a 17.7-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: K2-332 b was found in 2021 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-332. Its orbit and size follow de Leon et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DE_LEON_ET_AL_2021): disc_year 2021, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 17.70632, pl_radj 0.19627119, pl_bmassj 0.0172

quotes.title: K2-332 b
quotes.card: K2-332 b is a potentially habitable Super-Earth or Mini-Neptune exoplanet with a radius of 2.2 Earths.
quotes.introduction: It is in the empirical habitable zone, receiving 1.17 times the light that Earth gets from the sun.
